race.comment: PRINCESS KREKA NZ (2) is a newcomer to the John Stariha yard from NZ. Has had two months off since her latest appearance at Alexandra Park but is likely to get the favours from this nice draw so can make an immediate impact. RESERVED FOR ME (5) looks close to a win after finishing second in her last two outings at this circuit and distance, last time just 1.2 metres from the winner. Big chance to go one better. ONE WICKED DAY (4) produced a good effort on debut last start, finishing third from this barrier. Has plenty of scope for improvement. HEIRTOTHECROWN (7) draws wide but there was merit in the latest effort when fourth last week.
